description: This Java class implements a custom RecordReader for reading ORC files in Spark, providing methods for initialization, reading next record, and retrieving metadata like object inspector and progress.

classes.name: SparkOrcNewRecordReader
classes.description: A custom RecordReader for reading ORC files in Spark, exposing methods for reading records, progress, and object inspector.

methods.name: SparkOrcNewRecordReader
methods.description: Constructor initializing the reader with file, configuration, offset, and length.

methods.name: getCurrentKey
methods.description: Returns the current key, which is NullWritable.

methods.name: getProgress
methods.description: Returns the reading progress as a float.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the record reader with input split and task context.

methods.name: nextKeyValue
methods.description: Advances to the next record if available, updating progress.

methods.name: getObjectInspector
methods.description: Returns the ObjectInspector associated with the ORC file.
